Given a long-dated 2026 horizon, a probability jump rarely translates into an imminent, tradable 12h move in a broad ETF unless paired with a concrete resignation headline. I treat the mapping as weak and directionally unclear.

llm_justification.summary: A sharp move in the Netanyahu-out probability points to Israeli political-leadership risk, best proxied by the iShares MSCI Israel ETF (EIS) and, weakly, the shekel. However the sign of any equity/FX reaction is genuinely ambiguous — his exit could be read as de-escalatory or destabilizing — and a long-dated 2026 question rarely produces a tradable 7%+ 12h move without a concrete resignation headline. I map this as unclear direction with low confidence; it is not a tradable signal by the stated threshold unless a hard headline lands.
